errors.text_span: etwa 750 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 1987
errors.evidence: The initial value for the TSE line (purple) in 1987 is approximately 820, not 750.

errors.text_span: etwa 600 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 2017
errors.evidence: The final value for the TSE line (purple) in 2017 is 500, not 600.

errors.text_span: Sie steigt zunächst leicht auf etwa 850 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 1989 an, bevor sie auf etwa 700 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 1991 abfällt.
errors.evidence: This description of the TSE line's movement is incorrect. The line falls from 1987 to 1989 (from ~820 to ~730), and then rises sharply to a peak of ~980 in 1991. The stated values of 850 and 700 are also incorrect.

errors.text_span: Anschließend steigt sie erneut auf etwa 1000 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 2001 an und fällt danach auf etwa 500 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 2009 ab
errors.evidence: The description for the TSE line contains multiple errors. The peak of nearly 1000 is in 2003, not 2001 (in 2001 the value is ~820). The value in 2009 is approximately 580, not 500; the value of 500 is reached in 2011.

errors.text_span: etwa 550 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 1987
errors.evidence: The initial value for the TSEC line (green) in 1987 is over 600 (approximately 620), not 550.

errors.text_span: Sie steigt zunächst auf etwa 700 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 1989 an
errors.evidence: The TSEC line (green) does not rise in 1989. It peaks in 1988 at approximately 680 and then falls to a value below 500 in 1989.

errors.text_span: bevor sie auf etwa 50 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 2013 abfällt
errors.evidence: The TSEC line (green) reaches its minimum value of approximately 50 in the year 2011, not 2013. By 2013, the value has risen again to about 120.

errors.text_span: etwa 500 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 2017
errors.evidence: The final value for the TSEB line (blue) in 2017 is approximately 420, not 500.

errors.text_span: steigt kontinuierlich auf etwa 450 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 2003 an
errors.evidence: The TSEB line (blue) reaches a peak in 2003, but the value is approximately 580, not 450.
Describing the rise of the TSEB line as 'continuous' is an over-generalization, as there are small visible fluctuations and dips in its upward trend until 2003.

errors.text_span: und dann bis 2017 auf etwa 500 Euro pro Hektar ansteigt
errors.evidence: The TSEB line (blue) does not rise to 500 by 2017. It fluctuates and ends at a value of approximately 420.
